plan.authority: Standing bounded foreground HF Jobs approval and owner-reported sufficient prepaid balance. No top-up, private upload, human contact or scheduler.

circle.claim: Concrete parameters, not an equal-security claim against Groth16 or a backend qualification
circle.lifting_domain: All trees lifted to log_rows + 4; quadratic constraints with an explicit a*b product column and unbatched LogUp entries use degree bound log_rows + 1.

plan.failures: Retain every failure, timeout and sample. Do not omit failed samples from the report or automatically retry. A corrected candidate needs a new experiment identity and source freeze.
plan.fresh: New empty per-sample workspace, compilation/preprocessing and setup included; operating-system caches are not flushed. No retraining or model selection.
plan.fresh_compilation: New empty Rust target / Go object cache for each fresh backend workflow. Reuse the pinned installed toolchains and locked downloaded dependency sources; no retraining. Record compile logs, toolchain/binary/source hashes and cache sizes. Remove only successful derived object caches after retaining the binary and records; preserve all failed builds.

gnark.historical_results: immutable; not reused as matched samples
gnark.overlay_boundary: Apply timing-only observations to an isolated copy; canonical circuits and native LLM source inventory remain unchanged. Verify compiled R1CS identity against the frozen baseline.
gnark.setup: Fresh local synthetic setup; no reviewed ceremony

plan.host: one HF Jobs cpu-upgrade Linux x86-64 worker; both backends in the same job
plan.input_storage: Retain one canonical setup/program per fresh workflow. Install bounded hash-pinned inputs for each worker, then remove only successful duplicate materializations after recording exact canonical references; preserve failed inputs. Record input-copy time, logical bytes, allocated block sum and free space; unique physical bytes may be unavailable.
plan.ordering: Run every fresh sample first, then every warm sample; alternate gnark/circle order by repetition index. Native-only and native-plus-binding are measured separately for every case and repetition.
plan.policy: Retain gnark default. Publish a measured adopt/retain-both/reject recommendation only after complete coverage, composition and repetitions pass.
prior_failed_fixtures: HF fixture job 6ae0f7b441e90535df76716c failed before compilation: missing runs parent. No matched sample. All outputs retained and bucket deleted.
HF fixture job 6ae0f89041e90535df7672d0: isolated Go build omitted its go:embed encoder-graph.json asset; all outputs retained and bucket deleted. No matched sample.
HF fixture job 6ae0f91941e90535df767391: frozen R1CS matched and proof generated; isolated py-ecc entry point imported missing cbor2. Outputs retained and bucket deleted; no matched sample.
plan.prior_trials: Mac acceptance/conformance and the disk-admission failure are separate records. No Mac timing is mixed with this Linux campaign; no historical matched sample is reused.

raw_result_schema.failures: Keep partial samples and worker stdout/stderr/cost, exit status, timeouts and memory/storage boundary failures; no automatic rerun or deletion
raw_result_schema.missing_measurements: null with a reason; never encode unavailable timing as zero
raw_result_schema.native_scope: Each native-only/native-plus-binding observation covers all three classifiers for one request; the verifier caller recomputation remains included in caller_binding_seconds
raw_result_schema.shared_stages: Compiler and per-classifier setup/preprocessing commands, timings, artifact bytes and hashes; totals and amortization denominator three requests explicit
raw_result_schema.worker_cost_schema: hallmark.linux-compile-cost/1 reused bounded/seccomp worker mechanics; the schema name does not characterize the proof system

plan.sample_ids: {fresh|warm}-{zero_based_repetition:02d}-{gnark|circle}; each contains allow, cnn-block, rule-block and exactly rule, mlp, encoder proofs per case
plan.sample_unit: One complete three-request workflow (nine proofs per backend); every request/classifier pair therefore has three fresh and five warm samples.
plan.scope: integrity-only fixed exported rule, seed-17 MLP and seed-17 contextual CNN
plan.shared_costs: Compilation once per fresh backend workflow; setup/preprocessing once per classifier, shared across the three requests. Report totals and amortization denominator explicitly; reuse no earlier fresh workflow artifact.
plan.spread_definition: Median and inclusive linear-interpolation 25th/75th percentiles on successful samples; report range, IQR, failures and attempted/successful counts separately.
plan.warm: New proof and fresh proof-only verifier process per case; reuse the first admitted program/setup/preprocessing for this backend and case. No reuse of a proof or acceptance flag.
plan.worker_environment: Four prover threads. Existing Linux controller sets Go GOMEMLIMIT to three quarters of the 28 GiB worker cap. Fresh Go builds use -p=1 with GOMAXPROCS=4; Rust builds use -j4, release codegen-units=1. Network access is denied for proof workers; no witness/native trace is passed to proof-only verifiers.
